preconditions.description: n is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The input sequence a contains exactly n-1 integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 10**9 for val in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence a is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 lines, one for each starting index i from 1 to n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and (line == '-1' or line.isdigit()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either the string '-1' or a non-negative integer string.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda i, line: (line == '-1') or (line == str(final_y(i, a))))(i, output_lines[i-1]) for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: For each i from 1 to n-1, the i-th output line is '-1' if the simulation starting with a1=i does not terminate, or the final value of y if it terminates.
